message.reasoning_content:

This is classic "受贿" (accepting bribes) under the Criminal Law of PRC, article 385 (formerly 385, now 385?). Also possibly "滥用职权" but main is bribery. He also gave information to a bidding agency for a fee, also bribery. So crime: "受贿罪". Also maybe "行贿罪" is for the briber, not for him. So answer: [罪名]受贿罪<eoa>. The format: {"final_answer": "[罪名]受贿罪<eoa>"}.

Check if multiple crimes: Could be "受贿罪" and "泄露国家秘密"? No. It's just bribery. So single.
